source.title: Indris - Chain Breaker
source.name: Indris
source.description: An incredibly skilled archer who can fire several arrows at once to hit targets.

skills.name: Spellbane Shot

description.raw: Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage. The shot disables the enemy's stat buffs for 8s and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF by 20% for the rest of the battle. Unstackable. The buff-disabling effect doesn't work on Bosses.
active: Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage.
The shot disables the enemy's stat buffs for 8s and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF by 20% for the rest of the battle.
The buff-disabling effect doesn't work on Bosses.

text: When Indris fires a silencing arrow at a target with exposed weakness, he deals extra true damage equal to 20% of the exposed target's max HP.
Increases the damage of the silencing arrow to 260% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases the damage of the silencing arrow to 280% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases the damage of the silencing arrow to 300% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, preventing their stats from increasing for a while and reducing their Phys & Magic DEF for the rest of the battle.

skills.name: True Sight

description.raw: Passive. When an enemy is afflicted by at least 3 different stat reduction debuffs from Indris or his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed. Indris' normal attacks deal 60% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) extra true damage to enemies with exposed weakness. This effect can trigger once every 4s per enemy. In addition, Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows, each dealing 165% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage. The arrows prioritize different enemies with exposed weaknesses. If all 3 arrows hit the same target, the second and third arrows deal 25% less damage.
passive: When an enemy is afflicted by at least 3 different stat reduction debuffs from Indris or his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed.
Indris' normal attacks deal 60% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) extra true damage to enemies with exposed weakness.
This effect can trigger once every 4s per enemy.
In addition, Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows, each dealing 165% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage.
The arrows prioritize different enemies with exposed weaknesses.
If all 3 arrows hit the same target, the second and third arrows deal 25% less damage.

text: Increases the damage of each arrow triggered by True Sight to 170% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases the damage of each arrow triggered by True Sight to 175% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases the damage of each arrow triggered by True Sight to 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: When an enemy is afflicted by multiple debuffs from Indris and his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed. Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows and deals extra true damage to enemies with exposed weakness.

skills.name: Arcane Binding

description.raw: Indris knocks back all enemies within 2 tiles, pushing them out of the 2-tile area surrounding him. He then casts a binding spell on the nearest enemy, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and immobilizing them for 5s.
active: Indris knocks back all enemies within 2 tiles, pushing them out of the 2-tile area surrounding him.
He then casts a binding spell on the nearest enemy, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and immobilizing them for 5s.

skills.description_lite: Indris knocks back nearby enemies, then casts a binding spell that immobilizes the nearest enemy.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Indris increases his ATK by 6% during battle, plus an extra 9% if an enemy has exposed weakness.
active: Indris increases his ATK by 6% during battle, plus an extra 9% if an enemy has exposed weakness.

text: Indris increases his ATK by 8% during battle, plus an extra 12% if an enemy has exposed weakness.
Indris increases his ATK by 10% during battle, plus an extra 15% if an enemy has exposed weakness.

skills.description_lite: Indris increases his ATK during battle, which increases further if any enemy has an exposed weakness.

skills.name: Windpiercer

description.raw: Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD by 40 for 6s. Unstackable.
active: Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD by 40 for 6s.

text: Increases the ATK SPD Indris gains when triggering the exposed weakness damage bonus to 50.
Indris' normal attacks reduce the target's Phys DEF by 20% for 6s.
Increases the ATK SPD Indris gains when triggering the exposed weakness damage bonus to 60.

skills.description_lite: Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD for a period of time.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: After hitting an enemy with Arcane Binding, Indris's normal attacks can trigger the exposed weakness damage bonus without cooldown for 5s.
active: After hitting an enemy with Arcane Binding, Indris's normal attacks can trigger the exposed weakness damage bonus without cooldown for 5s.

skills.description_lite: After hitting an enemy with Arcane Binding, Indris can trigger the exposed weakness damage without cooldown for a while.
